Hi Priya / Jordan 

Thanks for the intro. From a sequencing and internal turn time standpoint we recommend:

1) NDA (clean)  we can accept your redline or provide ours; typical turnaround: 1-3 business days if no material changes.
2) MSA  we provide a standard MSA and a redline guidance doc (attached); typical first-pass redline turn time: 3-7 business days depending on scope of commercial/legal comments.
3) DPA  we prefer to negotiate after commercial terms are agreed (post-MSA) but can provide a standard DPA for parallel review if that expedites privacy sign-off; privacy review usually 3-10 business days.

Docs that speed review: SOC 2 report, data flow diagram for payment events, and a short summary of retention policies. I’ll ask our security team to share SOC 2 and a high-level data flows doc once you confirm an NDA is in place.

If you have specific commercial redlines (liability caps, indemnity language, data residency clauses), flag those early so we can pull in finance and product teams.

Regards,
